title: Strong Converses for Quantum Channel Capacities from Blowing-Up Lemmata
summary: A quantum channel can transmit quantum states, classical messages, or classical messages that remain secret from its environment. We prove exponential strong converses for all three tasks over arbitrary finite-dimensional memoryless quantum channels, at their respective regularized capacities and allowing arbitrary entangled inputs across channel uses and joint decoding. Above quantum or classical capacity, entanglement fidelity or decoding success probability, respectively, decays exponentially with the number of channel uses.
